response.sql: WITH scan_rates AS (SELECT s.riskeval, sc.gbsize / sc.spanmin AS rate FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin > 0), group_averages AS (SELECT riskeval, AVG(rate) AS group_avg_rate FROM scan_rates GROUP BY riskeval), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(group_avg_rate) AS benchmark_value FROM group_averages), above_benchmark AS (SELECT ga.group_avg_rate, (ga.group_avg_rate - b.benchmark_value) AS margin FROM group_averages ga CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE ga.group_avg_rate > b.benchmark_value) SELECT AVG(group_avg_rate) AS average_rate, AVG(margin) AS average_margin FROM above_benchmark

assumptions.assumption: Scans with NULL or non-positive spanmin, or NULL gbsize, are excluded from the rate calculation, since these would produce invalid or undefined rates.

Multiple groups with average rates strictly above the benchmark are aggregated into a single result row showing their combined average rate and average margin, rather than returning one row per group.

alternatives.interpretation: Return one row per group with average rate strictly above the benchmark, each row containing the group's riskeval, its average rate, and its margin above the benchmark.
alternatives.sql: WITH scan_rates AS (SELECT s.riskeval, sc.gbsize / sc.spanmin AS rate FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin > 0), group_averages AS (SELECT riskeval, AVG(rate) AS group_avg_rate FROM scan_rates GROUP BY riskeval), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(group_avg_rate) AS benchmark_value FROM group_averages) SELECT ga.riskeval, ga.group_avg_rate AS average_rate, (ga.group_avg_rate - b.benchmark_value) AS average_margin FROM group_averages ga CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE ga.group_avg_rate > b.benchmark_value ORDER BY ga.group_avg_rate DESC
